section_description: Comprehensive IT services built on security and trust, not surveillance.

items.title: Security-First Architecture
items.description: Traditional IT tools are like a stranger having a master key to your house. We use 'Zero-Trust'—we don't keep a key. Instead, we use secure, private tunnels that only open when needed.

items.title: Endpoint Management
items.description: PC and Mac management without invasive monitoring. Patching, updates, and configuration management that respects user privacy.

items.title: Network Management
items.description: Robust network infrastructure, monitoring, and optimization. From firewalls to WiFi, we ensure your network runs smoothly and securely.

items.title: Backup & Recovery
items.description: Automated backup solutions with tested recovery procedures. Because data loss isn't acceptable—we make sure you're always protected.

items.title: Unlimited Support
items.description: 24/7 professional support when you need it. No ticket limits, no tier restrictions. Direct access to your support team.

items.title: Proactive Maintenance
items.description: Regular system maintenance, health checks, and optimization. We prevent problems before they impact your business.
